response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a grand, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the 14th century.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly! We must be ahead of the curve. We must be... (he gestures grandly)...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his courtiers, all of whom are dressed in the latest fashions from the future. They are all wearing pastel-colored robes with intricate, swirling patterns.

KING
(to his courtiers)
I want our aesthetic to reflect the beauty of the unknown. The mystique of the future.

COURTIER 1 (she)
Yes, Your Majesty. We can achieve this by incorporating more... (she consults a book)...neon colors and distorted, VHS-style visuals.

KING
(nodding enthusiastically)
Exactly! And we must also incorporate more... (he thinks for a moment)...found sounds. The hum of machinery, the chatter of the common folk.

COURTIER 2 (he)
I can arrange for a team of musicians to create a soundscape of industrial machinery and... (he consults another book)...tape hiss.

KING
(smiling)
Brilliant! And we must also update our architecture to reflect the... (he gestures to a nearby window)...the futuristic.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now transformed. The buildings are adorned with neon lights and distorted, VHS-style visuals. The streets are filled with strange, futuristic contraptions, including hoverbikes and... (he looks up)... robots.

KING
(to his courtiers)
Behold! Our empire is now a beacon of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

COURTIER 3 (she)
It's... (she looks around in awe)...it's like nothing I've ever seen before, Your Majesty.

KING
(smiling)
That is the power of vision, my friends. The power of... (he gestures grandly)...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is now surrounded by his courtiers, all of whom are dressed in their finest, most futuristic attire. They are all sipping strange, glowing drinks and... (he looks around)...listening to music.

KING
(to his courtiers)
Let us celebrate our new era of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

COURTIER 1 (she)
To the king! May our empire forever be... (she raises her glass)...vaporwave!

The courtiers all cheer and raise their glasses in a toast to the king and his vision of a futuristic, vaporwave empire.

FADE TO BLACK.
